Jordan: Passing the baton for Appara (Enterprise) — signed last week. Quick context: committed Dedicated (2x GPUs), SSO + SCIM, private deploy targeted for Q2. Open items: provisioning ETA, demo env creds, data ingestion CSV schema, renewal timeline.

Maria: Thanks Jordan. Can you confirm provisioning ETA and the primary infra contact at Appara?

Alex: I can own provisioning. Need cloud account ID + SAML IdP metadata. @Jordan can you drop the account id? Also, do they want static egress IPs for private deploy?

Jordan: Account ID is AP-7882. They do want static egress IPs. Sales note attached: https://redwood.internal/sales/AP-7882 (internal). SAML metadata pending from their Okta admin — I'll follow up today.

Olivia: Heads-up from product: they requested a custom prompt template evaluation for compliance reasons. @Maria can we include that in the kickoff?

Maria: Scheduling a 30-min kickoff tomorrow 10:00am PT. Invite will include Alex + Olivia. Action owners captured below:
- Alex: provision dedicated cluster + enable 30d logs
- Maria: run kickoff + produce onboarding plan
- Jordan: deliver SAML metadata + IP allowlist + billing contact
- Support: run a perf smoke test during onboarding

Alex: Created infra ticket INC-3421 to track provisioning. ETA Wed EOD. Provision command for reference:
```
redwood tenant create --id AP-7882 --dedicated --gpu 2 --region us-west-2
```
Also enabling log retention flag: `--logs-retention 30d`.

Jordan: Pinged customer for SAML metadata and IP list. Also looped in billing; they'll need invoice by 5/1.

Maria: Flagging renewal risk as MEDIUM — customer voiced throughput concerns. We'll run a perf evaluation during onboarding and report results to renewal lead. Opening CS ticket CS-9876 and linking INC-3421.

Olivia: Please add two eval prompt sets to the support ticket: `production-latency` and `compliance-safety`. Product will review results within 3 business days of the run.

Alex: Added eval artifacts: https://redwood.internal/evals/AP-7882
Will attach perf logs and a canary rollout plan to INC-3421.

oncall-bot: Reminder — onboarding kickoff scheduled in ~23 hours. :bell:

Jordan: Thanks team :rocket:
